title: Battles of bands at the Pelican and out-of-town bands
summary: At the Pelican two bands sometimes played opposite each other; Bebe Ridley, Clarence Williams and Bud Scott are asked about.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

At Pelican, sometimes they would have two. At times they'd have what they call a jazz festival, I think they called it that. They'd have two bands, you know. One playing opposite the other.
